description: This file defines a serializer and copier for the IPAddress type within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for reading and writing IPAddress instances to a binary wire format, handling references, and raw byte serialization.

classes.name: IPAddressCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing serialization and deserialization logic for IPAddress objects, including reading, writing, and handling references.

classes.name: IPAddressCopier
classes.description: A sealed class for shallow copying IPAddress instances, supporting derived type copying within Orleans serialization.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an IPAddress value from the buffer, handling reference tracking if applicable.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads the raw length-prefixed IPAddress bytes from the buffer and constructs an IPAddress object.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes an IPAddress value to the buffer, including reference handling and length-prefixed serialization.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes the raw length-prefixed IPAddress bytes to the buffer.
